reason: Devon Energy Corporation's 10-K filing does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) estimates. As an upstream oil and gas exploration and production company, Devon focuses on operational metrics (reserves, production volumes, realized prices) rather than market size quantification. The filing contains extensive discussion of proved reserves, production volumes, and operational areas (Delaware Basin, Rockies, Eagle Ford, Anadarko Basin), but no company-disclosed TAM figures for oil, natural gas, or NGL markets.
